purpose: Compare output current and mounting heat requirements before selecting a replacement for the small follower and sink devices.

scope: Ideal class-A pair calculation. Excludes feedback current, gate charging, gain-stage heat, bias tolerances, faults and shared heat from other parts. Current floor is a load-only lower bound. No physical model, SOA, sourcing or fit qualification.
headroom_basis: 135V peak/20kHz is a retained overload stress, not the normal 25W clean requirement. 100/250/500pF are load scenarios, not measured wiring capacitance.
